passages.title: Passage 1
passages.instructions:
Questions 1–40

You should spend about 60 minutes on Questions 1–40, which are based on the reading passage below.
passages.body:
Behavioural Economics and Nudges

A Behavioural economics integrates psychological evidence that individuals deviate from rational choice models through present bias, loss aversion, and social norms shaping savings, health, and energy decisions. Nudges alter choice architecture—default enrolment, label framing, social comparisons—without forbidding options, aiming to steer toward welfare-improving behaviour while preserving liberty as contrasted with mandates or taxes. Thaler and Sunstein popularised libertarian paternalism, sparking government units from behavioural insights teams testing letter wording increasing tax compliance or organ donation registration via opt-out defaults controversial among ethicists fearing manipulation and among traditional economists sceptical of small effect sizes failing cost-benefit thresholds when scaled nationally across heterogeneous populations with unequal literacy and trust in institutions crafting messages.

B Defaults powerfully influence pension participation when employers auto-enrol workers with ability to opt out, raising coverage compared with opt-in forms ignored on desks. Commitment devices and labelled savings accounts help some households overcome procrastination, though liquidity constraints limit uptake among low-income families. Simplified choice sets reduce paralysis in insurance exchanges, yet oversimplification may hide vital coverage gaps. Randomised controlled trials in field settings provide credible impact estimates, inspiring evidence-based policy movements while raising external validity questions when pilots run with enthusiastic agencies not representative of bureaucratic inertia nationwide implementing at scale with vendor contracts and IT failures delaying rollouts undermining projected savings assumptions used to justify budgets to legislatures skeptical

C Health nudges include placing healthier foods at eye level in cafeterias, displaying calorie counts, and sending appointment reminders reducing missed visits. Critics argue structural determinants—poverty, shift work, food deserts— dwarf label tweaks, risking victim-blaming narratives if politicians cite nudges instead of investing in clinics and wages. Environmental applications prompt home energy reports comparing consumption to neighbours, achieving modest reductions with rebound effects partially offsetting gains when savings fund additional usage elsewhere in household budgets. Digital platforms A/B test button colours and notification timing harvesting behavioural data at unprecedented granularity, blurring line between public policy nudges and commercial dark patterns exploiting biases regulators struggle to define legally without chilling legitimate marketing

D Ethical frameworks demand transparency, easy opt-outs, and welfare criteria judged by affected individuals not only planners. Sludge audits identify burdensome paperwork harming vulnerable groups, pairing nudge agendas with simplification removing frictions deliberately inserted by incumbents protecting rents. Paternalism debates question whether apparent preferences revealed by choices always reflect true interests when learning is costly and advertising manipulates desires. Developing countries adapt nudges to mobile money contexts skipping legacy paperwork, achieving high uptake of savings prompts via SMS though network outages and illiteracy require voice-based alternatives and agent networks trusted locally rather than one-size SMS templates designed in capital cities distant from rural users' lived constraints and seasonal cash flow rhythms

E Organisational behaviour applies nudges internally: meeting defaults shortened, performance feedback timed strategically, diversity prompts in hiring systems reducing biased shortlists when structured rubrics accompany reminders. Unintended consequences include complacency if employees perceive manipulation, eroding trust. Union negotiators demand clarity on surveillance metrics derived from behavioural monitoring wearables entering workplaces promising safety nudges yet enabling punitive productivity scoring. Public sector procurement now requests trial evidence before funding nationwide campaigns printing behavioural slogans on buses, a maturation from early enthusiasm toward accountability aligning with fiscal conservatism after high-profile failures where nudges produced null results published reluctantly yet valuably preventing waste replication if open science norms prevail across agencies sharing null findings repositories

F Relation to traditional policy instruments matters: carbon taxes change prices directly, while nudges may complement but rarely substitute when externalities large. Subsidies for insulation plus simplifed application defaults illustrate layering. Political feasibility sometimes favours nudges because they avoid explicit tax votes, a democratic deficit if used to circumvent debate. Academic curricula now teach behavioural modules alongside micro foundations, training analysts to spot biases in their own forecasting avoiding overconfidence traps behavioural research documented among experts as well as laypeople, meta-analytically replicated across domains from finance to medicine where checklists and premortems mitigate planning fallacies killing projects that might have succeeded with realistic reference class forecasting instead of best-case storytelling to

G Looking ahead, the author believes nudges belong in toolkit with transparency and equity audits, not as excuse for austerity neglecting structural reform. Personalised nudges via algorithms risk segmentation and privacy harms unless governed. Citizen assemblies could review architectures affecting collective choices like pension defaults and organ donation rules balancing autonomy and welfare. If behavioural units become public relations shields, credibility will collapse. Rigorous evaluation, publication of failures, and democratic legitimacy distinguish ethical nudge practice from covert manipulation or corporate exploitation, preserving insights that small frictions matter while acknowledging limits when power imbalances and scarcity dominate lives no wording tweak alone can remedy without redistribution and rights enforcement underpinning real freedom
